town: Long time ago, for one town for Hausaland, people dey live dia life the way dem don always dey live am.
day: For afternoon, the streets dey busy, people dey go do dia work, and the town full with life.
night: But when night reach, something change.
dodo: One creature dey wey dem dey call Dodo.
feared: Everybody dey fear Dodo, and people sabi say make nobody try challenge am.
came: One night, Dodo enter the town.
darkness: As e dey waka for inside darkness, e shout well well:
challenge: “For this town, who fit fight with me?”
silent-people: People hear am, but nobody get mind to answer.
doors: Dem lock dia doors. People hide anywhere wey dem fit hide.
grain: Some people fear reach where dem climb enter dia grain store and siddon there, dey hope say the creature no go find dem.
boy: Auta na small boy wey dey stay with one old woman.
stranger: E be stranger for the town, e dey stay for her house.
heard: When e hear Dodo challenge, e answer:
believe: The old woman no fit believe wetin she hear.
begged: She ask am if e don craze, and she beg am make e come inside.
dangerous: She sabi how Dodo dangerous reach, and she no understand why small boy go wan challenge that kain creature.
fire: Instead, e go meet the fire.
stones: E carry seven stones put for inside the fire, make dem hot well well.
stones.ask: Why Auta make the stones hot?
approached: No long time, Dodo reach the house.
doorway: The creature come reach the entrance. E big reach where e must bend down before e fit pass the low door.
moment: Na that moment Auta dey wait for.
throw: As Dodo bend to enter, Auta carry one of the hot stones and throw am straight enter the creature mouth.
backed: The creature back comot from the door and stand up straight again.
challenge-3: “Who for this town fit fight with me?”
answered: And one more time, Auta answer.
returned: The creature come back to the door.
bent: Again, e bend down to enter.
again-stone: Again, Auta throw one hot stone enter im mouth.
repeatedly: Na so e continue dey happen.
each-time: Every time Dodo challenge the town, Auta go answer. Every time the creature near the door, Auta go throw another hot stone enter im mouth.
all-seven: Until all the seven stones finish.
could-not: At last, Dodo no fit continue again.
dead: By the time morning reach, the creature don die.
dead.ask: How the stones take kill Dodo?
dawn: The next morning, early early, the women for the town comot go fetch water.
body: Dem see Dodo body wey lie down for the street.
alarm: Wetin dem see make dem fear, and dem shout raise alarm.
spread: Quick quick, the news spread for the whole town.
horsemen: The king send horsemen make dem go check the creature, but one strange thing happen.
horses: Dia horses no gree go near Dodo body.
would-not: Anything wey the horsemen do, the animals no gree go near am.
nobody-knew: Nobody understand how dem take defeat the creature.
tail: E don carry Dodo tail for night, and e show am as proof say na im kill the creature.
knew: Now people know who answer Dodo challenge.
was-auta: Na Auta, the young stranger wey dey stay with the old woman.
reward: The king reward am because of im bravery.
end: And na so Auta take defeat the terrible Dodo with seven hot stones.
end.ask: Wetin we fit learn from Auta?
